type_en: silver filigree necklace set with Islamic coins
visual_en: Double-strand necklace of silver-tone filigree beads with five flower-shaped filigree medallions, each set with a silver Islamic-style coin (Kufic dirham type). Shown on a black bust stand.
facts_en: Coins show Kufic legends (not read) (#1242).
notes_en: Single photo. Not the same object as the W pendants shot 40 min earlier (#1238-1241, outside range) - checked.

type_en: pendant set with an Islamic silver dirham
visual_en: Round silver dirham-type coin with Kufic legends in a cut-scalloped openwork silver-tone frame with a diamond-cut bail.
facts_en: Coin centre reads «لا اله الا الله وحده لا شريك له» in Kufic, with a circular margin legend beginning «بسم الله ...» (Umayyad/Abbasid dirham style; authenticity not judged) (#1243).
notes_en: Single photo; same night as the necklace #1242 but a separate object.

type_en: men's ring with engraved carnelian (Hussein Jeddi)
visual_en: Large oval orange-brown carnelian engraved with a multi-line Arabic inscription split by a horizontal line; silver-tone bezel with beaded rim on a diamond-knurled shank.
facts_en: Hallmarks on the inside of the shank: two oval Persian-script marks (one looks like «تهران»?, the other unread, possibly a maker's name) with an F-shaped mark, the same set seen on the other Hussein Jeddi rings in this range (#1246).
notes_en: Files JWL-0013-1..3.

type_en: men's ring with engraved red carnelian (Hussein Jeddi)
visual_en: Oval red carnelian engraved in a cartouche, held by tall petal-shaped claws; ribbed, partly openwork silver shank.
facts_en: Engraving reads «يا حي يا قيوم» (#1247). Hallmarks on the inside of the shank: two oval Persian-script marks (one looks like «تهران»?, the other unread, possibly a maker's name) with an F-shaped mark, the same set seen on the other Hussein Jeddi rings in this range (#1249).
notes_en: Files JWL-0014-1..3.

type_en: men's ring with engraved honey agate (Hussein Jeddi)
visual_en: Large oval honey-brown agate engraved in four ruled lines; polished bezel with beaded rim on a diamond-knurled silver shank.
facts_en: Engraving is Surat al-Falaq: «بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم قل اعوذ برب الفلق من شر ما خلق ومن شر غاسق اذا وقب ومن شر النفاثات في العقد ومن شر حاسد اذا حسد» (#1250, #1251, #1253). Hallmarks inside shank (#1254).
notes_en: Owner's file names JWL-0015-1, JWL-0016-1/-2 and JWL-0017-1/-2 are ONE ring: #1250 and the close-up #1251 show the identical engraving layout, and the side view #1253 matches it line for line (the stone looks greyer there only because of the light angle). #1252 is the same frame as #1251 (d=0).

type_en: men's ring with engraved white chalcedony (Hussein Jeddi)
visual_en: Oval milky-white chalcedony engraved with a few words in large script and a 4-digit number; beaded bezel on a diagonally fluted silver shank.
facts_en: Number on the stone may be a date (reads like ١٠٤٥ ?) (#1255, #1257). Two oval hallmarks inside the shank (#1258).
notes_en: Files JWL-0018-1 (close-up) and JWL-0019-1..3 are the same stone (identical engraving and number).

type_en: men's ring with engraved red carnelian (Hussein Jeddi)
visual_en: Oval deep-red carnelian engraved with several rows of names; beaded bezel on a diamond-knurled silver shank.
facts_en: Engraving lists the Fourteen Infallibles: «الله محمد علي فاطمة حسن حسين علي محمد جعفر موسى علي محمد علي حسن ...» (#1259, #1260). Hallmarks on the inside of the shank: two oval Persian-script marks (one looks like «تهران»?, the other unread, possibly a maker's name) with an F-shaped mark, the same set seen on the other Hussein Jeddi rings in this range (#1261).
notes_en: Files JWL-0002-1..3.

type_en: men's ring with engraved carnelian (Hussein Jeddi)
visual_en: Large oval orange carnelian engraved in seven lines; beaded bezel on a diamond-knurled silver shank.
facts_en: Engraving is Surat an-Nasr: «بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم اذا جاء نصر الله والفتح ورايت الناس يدخلون في دين الله افواجا فسبح بحمد ربك واستغفره انه كان توابا» (#1262, #1263). Hallmarks on the inside of the shank: two oval Persian-script marks (one looks like «تهران»?, the other unread, possibly a maker's name) with an F-shaped mark, the same set seen on the other Hussein Jeddi rings in this range (#1265).
notes_en: Files JWL-0020-1, JWL-0021-1 (close-up) and JWL-0022-1/-2 are one ring (same engraving layout, same mount).

type_en: men's ring with octagonal engraved carnelian
visual_en: Octagonal dark-red carnelian engraved in three lines; silver-tone bezel with beaded rim and sculpted, grooved shoulders.
facts_en: Engraving reads «ما شاء الله لا قوة الا بالله ان ترن انا اقل منك مالا وولدا» (Qur'an 18:39) (#1267).
notes_en: #1268 «DSC_7834 (1).jpg» is the same frame as #1269 (d=0). Shot in the middle of the Hussein Jeddi series but filed in RS; no hallmark photo.

type_en: men's ring with engraved white chalcedony (Hussein Jeddi)
visual_en: Oval milky-white chalcedony engraved with the Basmala; beaded bezel on a diagonally fluted silver shank.
facts_en: Engraving reads «بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم» (#1270). Two oval hallmarks inside the shank (#1272).
notes_en: Files JWL-0023-1..3.

type_en: men's ring with engraved yellow agate in a claw mount (Hussein Jeddi)
visual_en: Small oval yellow-to-orange agate engraved with calligraphy over a floral ground, held in a tall, angular flame-like claw mount; polished silver shank.
facts_en: Two oval Persian-script hallmarks inside the shank (#1275).
notes_en: Files JWL-0024-1 and JWL-0025-1/-2 are one ring (same stone and mount).

type_en: men's ring with engraved chalcedony (Hussein Jeddi)
visual_en: Oval grey-white chalcedony with orange edges engraved in two lines with small numerals; beaded bezel held by fluted petal claws on a fluted silver shank.
facts_en: Engraving reads approximately «... الله المحمود في كل فعاله» (?) (#1276, #1277). Hallmarks on the inside of the shank: two oval Persian-script marks (one looks like «تهران»?, the other unread, possibly a maker's name) with an F-shaped mark, the same set seen on the other Hussein Jeddi rings in this range (#1278).
notes_en: Files JWL-0026-1 and JWL-0027-1/-2 are one ring.

type_en: men's ring with engraved carnelian, knot calligraphy (Hussein Jeddi)
visual_en: Oval orange carnelian engraved with an interlaced knot-style calligraphic composition and rosettes; beaded bezel on a lattice-textured silver shank.
facts_en: Small numerals in the engraving, not read (#1279, #1280). Hallmarks on the inside of the shank: two oval Persian-script marks (one looks like «تهران»?, the other unread, possibly a maker's name) with an F-shaped mark, the same set seen on the other Hussein Jeddi rings in this range (#1281).
notes_en: Files JWL-0028-1 and JWL-0029-1/-2 are one ring.

type_en: men's ring with engraved carnelian (Hussein Jeddi)
visual_en: Large oval orange carnelian engraved in seven lines; beaded bezel on a diamond-knurled silver shank.
facts_en: Engraving is Surat al-Kafirun: «بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم قل يا ايها الكافرون لا اعبد ما تعبدون ... لكم دينكم ولي دين» (#1282, #1283). Hallmarks on the inside of the shank: two oval Persian-script marks (one looks like «تهران»?, the other unread, possibly a maker's name) with an F-shaped mark, the same set seen on the other Hussein Jeddi rings in this range (#1286).
notes_en: Files JWL-0030-1 and JWL-0031-1..4 are one ring. #1285 (JWL-0031-3) is the same frame as #1284 (JWL-0031-2), d=0.

type_en: men's ring with engraved red carnelian
visual_en: Oval red carnelian engraved in three lines in a plain, heavy polished silver-tone mount.
facts_en: Engraving reads «لا اله الا انت سبحانك اني كنت من الظالمين» (#1288, #1290).
notes_en: DSC_7950 (front) and DSC_7965 (side) show the same stone. #1287 and #1289 are the «(1)» copies (d=0).

type_en: men's band ring with a single colourless stone (Hussein Jeddi)
visual_en: Silver band with one round colourless stone (diamond or white stone) in a square four-claw setting, flanked by engraved geometric star/cross panels.
notes_en: Files JWL-0032-1/-2. The hallmark shot taken next (#1293, JWL-0001-9) was judged to belong to the red-cabochon ring g7-17, not to this band (see there).

type_en: men's ring with red cabochon in a claw mount (Hussein Jeddi)
visual_en: Oval red cabochon (looks like carnelian/agate) held by tall, faceted claws; polished silver shank with beaded collar.
facts_en: Hallmarks on the inside of the shank: two oval Persian-script marks (one looks like «تهران»?, the other unread, possibly a maker's name) with an F-shaped mark, the same set seen on the other Hussein Jeddi rings in this range (#1293, #1303, #1307).
notes_en: Files JWL-0001-1..9. #1293 (JWL-0001-9) was shot 18 min before the rest, right after the band JWL-0032, but the owner's file name, and the out-of-focus red stone and silver claw in the foreground of #1293, tie it to this ring.

type_en: engraved carnelian pendant with gazelle bail
visual_en: Large oval carnelian pendant engraved with a central cartouche and a border inscription, in a scalloped silver-tone bezel with a heart-shaped openwork bail showing a gazelle; the back plate is engraved with a deer among flowers (#1295).
facts_en: Centre reads «لا اله الا انت سبحانك اني كنت من الظالمين»; the border begins «وان يكاد الذين كفروا ليزلقونك بابصارهم ...» (#1297, #1299).
notes_en: DSC_8028 (front+back), DSC_8031 and DSC_8040 are one pendant. #1294, #1296, #1298 are the «(1)» copies (d=0).

type_en: men's ring with engraved carnelian, twisted shank
visual_en: Oval orange-red carnelian engraved with large calligraphy over a floral ground; bezel edged with an engraved chevron band, on a twisted rope-style silver shank with ball joints.
notes_en: DSC_0756, DSC_0776 and DSC_0788 are one ring. #1308, #1310, #1312 are the «(1)» copies (d=0).

type_en: ring with engraved yellow agate
visual_en: Oval yellow-orange agate engraved with calligraphy and small floral motifs, in a plain bezel on a thin, plain silver-tone shank.
notes_en: DSC_0843 (front) and DSC_0851 (side) are one ring. Copies «(1)», «(2)», «(3)» are d=0.

type_en: gold bracelet with engraved agate plaques
visual_en: Gold-tone bracelet of five oval engraved agate/carnelian plaques (the largest in the centre) in filigree frames, with filigree drops and pearls hanging below; shown in its fitted box (#1320).
facts_en: Plaques engraved with Arabic inscriptions, not read (#1325, #1326).
notes_en: File names R024-1..7 look like an owner code. #1323 (R024-4) is the same frame as #1322 (R024-3), d=0.

type_en: men's ring with emerald (Hussein Jeddi)
visual_en: Emerald-cut green stone (looks like emerald) in a claw setting with fluted, linear-engraved shoulders; silver-tone.
facts_en: Hallmarks on the inside of the shank: two oval Persian-script marks (one looks like «تهران»?, the other unread, possibly a maker's name) with an F-shaped mark, the same set seen on the other Hussein Jeddi rings in this range (#1329).
notes_en: Files JWL-0007-1 and JWL-0008-1/-2 are one ring.

type_en: men's ring with red cabochon (Hussein Jeddi)
visual_en: Round red cabochon (looks like carnelian) held by four tab claws, with a central ridge and beaded grooves on broad polished silver shoulders.
notes_en: Files JWL-0009-1..3 and JWL-0010-1 are one ring (#1332 shows the same mount from above).

type_en: men's ring with engraved honey agate, openwork shank
visual_en: Large oval honey-brown agate engraved with calligraphy; bezel with a gold-tone beaded rim on an openwork cage-style striped silver shank.
facts_en: Hallmarks: two hexagonal Persian-script marks (unread) and an F-shaped mark (#1341); the same marks are on ring g7-31 (#1372).
notes_en: #1335, #1337, #1340 are the «(1)» copies (d=0). Same style and hallmarks as g7-31, so probably the same maker.

type_en: men's ring with green jade cabochon (Jeddi sons?)
visual_en: Large oval green cabochon (looks like jadeite jade) held in a petal/claw mount with faceted, flame-like shoulders; warm-toned silver.
facts_en: Hallmarks: two round marks with a short Persian word (unread) and an F-shaped mark (#1346); the same marks as on Ring-3 (#1384) and the HS ring g7-33 (#1380).
notes_en: Split across categories: the same three frames are filed in HS as «DSC_2608/2613/2622 copy.jpg» and in RS as «R005-1/-2/-3.jpg» (d=0). I kept the HS files and put the R005 copies in duplicates. Proposed category HS because the hallmark matches the HS pieces; note that the owner also gave it the code R005.

type_en: men's ring with sapphire and diamond halo
visual_en: Cushion-cut blue stone (looks like sapphire) in a claw setting framed by a halo of small colourless stones (diamonds?) in an octagonal head; brushed white-metal shoulders (silver-tone, possibly white gold).
notes_en: DSC_2637 copy (1)/(2)/(3) are copies of «DSC_2637 copy.jpg» (d=0).

type_en: men's ring with peridot
visual_en: Oval faceted yellow-green stone (looks like peridot) in a claw mount with angular, faceted shoulders; warm-toned silver.
facts_en: Hallmarks: two oval Persian-script marks and an F-shaped mark (#1355). They look the same as the Hussein Jeddi marks (#1246, #1293, #1329).
notes_en: Grouping is certain (#1355 shows the green stone). Category is unsure: it is filed in RS, but its hallmarks look like the H (Hussein Jeddi) set, while its mount resembles the HS jade ring g7-25. Lead may consider moving it to H.

type_en: heart-shaped engraved agate pendant on cord
visual_en: Heart-shaped orange agate/carnelian engraved with a large central word and a border inscription; gold bail; on a black cord with red knots.
facts_en: Centre reads «الله» (#1357, #1360). Gold bail stamped «750» (#1357).
notes_en: Copies «(1)», «(2)» are d=0 with «DSC_2674 copy» / «DSC_2679 copy».

type_en: men's ring with engraved agate
visual_en: Large oval grey-brown agate engraved in two lines; beaded bezel on a vertically striped silver shank.
facts_en: Engraving reads «بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم» and «انه من سليمان وانه» (Qur'an 27:30) (?) (#1361). Hallmarks: two oval Persian-script marks, different from the H and HS marks, no F visible (#1364).
notes_en: File names R011-1..4 look like an owner code.

type_en: men's ring with engraved carnelian
visual_en: Oval orange carnelian engraved in two lines split by a ruled line; beaded bezel on a stepped grid-textured silver shank.
facts_en: Looks like «لا اله الا الله محمد رسول الله» / «علي ولي الله» (?) (#1365, #1366). Single rectangular maker's mark (unread) inside the shank (#1368).

type_en: men's ring with engraved dark stone, openwork shank
visual_en: Oval matte dark brown/black stone engraved with central ruled lines and a border inscription; bezel with a gold-tone beaded rim on an openwork cage-style striped silver shank.
facts_en: Inscription not read (#1369, #1370). Hallmarks: two hexagonal marks and an F-shaped mark (#1372), the same as ring g7-24 (#1341).
notes_en: Same maker style and hallmarks as g7-24, but a different stone.

type_en: men's ring with engraved carnelian, chased floral shank (Hussein Jeddi)
visual_en: Oval red carnelian densely engraved in about six ruled lines; beaded bezel on shoulders chased with flowers and leaves; silver-tone.
facts_en: Engraving is the salawat on the Fourteen Infallibles: «اللهم صل على محمد المصطفى ... والبتول فاطمة ... والباقر محمد والصادق جعفر والكاظم موسى والرضا علي ...» (#1373). Two oval Persian-script hallmarks (#1376).
notes_en: Files JWL-0011-1 and JWL-0012-1..3 are one ring (same stone and floral shank).

type_en: men's ring with engraved carnelian (Jeddi sons)
visual_en: Oval orange carnelian engraved with calligraphy, small numerals and floral motifs, held by fluted petal claws on a deeply fluted silver shank.
facts_en: Hallmarks: two round marks with a short Persian word and an F-shaped mark (#1380), the same as on Ring-3 (#1384).

type_en: men's ring with Ayat al-Kursi on chalcedony (Ring-3)
visual_en: Large oval grey-white chalcedony engraved with Ayat al-Kursi in ruled lines; beaded bezel on a broad, plain polished silver shank.
facts_en: Engraving is Ayat al-Kursi: «الله لا اله الا هو الحي القيوم لا تاخذه سنة ولا نوم ... وهو العلي العظيم» (#1382). Hallmarks: two round marks and an F-shaped mark (#1384).
notes_en: Existing folder Ring-3 holds one object only (all four photos show the same stone and mount).
